intro.text: A dark-skinned skaa, Camon's second-in-command in a Luthadel thieving crew.

items.text: Served as Camon's second-in-command, and was given leadership of the crew by Kelsier.
Was slowly tortured to death by Steel Inquisitors seeking Vin's whereabouts; they tied him to a chair and gouged out his eyes as they questioned him.
